en.选择任务 → 填写预测 → 加载参数并运行 → 记录本次实验 → 写结论并完成任: Select task → Predict → Load and run → Record → Conclude and complete
en.我的预测（任务2必须先填写；首次开始实验后锁定，避免事后修改）: My prediction (required for task 2; locked on first run)
en.我的结论（引用数据，解释规律或模型局限）: My conclusion (use evidence to explain patterns or limitations)
en.固定初始角度10°、地球重力，测试5种摆长。记录周期后，解释摆长与周期的关系。: Keep the angle at 10° and Earth gravity. Test five lengths, record periods and explain the relationship.
en.先写下预测：摆长从0.25 m增至1 m（4倍），周期会变为几倍？再运行两组实验: Predict the period ratio when length increases from 0.25 m to 1 m (4 times). Then run both experiments to test your prediction.
en.固定1 m、地球重力，逐渐增大角度。此任务以偏差超过2%作为“明显偏离”的课堂标: Keep length at 1 m and Earth gravity. Increase the angle. This task uses deviation above 2% as a classroom criterion, not a universal physical boundary.
en.保持1 m、初始角度10°不变，比较地球与月球的周期，并解释重力的影响。: Keep length at 1 m and angle at 10°. Compare Earth and Moon periods and explain the effect of gravity.
en.请先在任务2填写周期将变为几倍及你的理由，再运行或单步。: Enter your predicted period ratio and reasoning in task 2 before running or stepping.
